description: Fetch incidents from Microsoft Defender XDR via the Microsoft Graph Security API (/security/incidents). Requires the Graph application permission `SecurityIncident.Read.All`.
name: Fetch incidents from Microsoft Defender XDR (Graph API)

timedelta.description: The temporal shift, in the past, in minutes, the connector applies when fetching incidents (default 5 minutes).

start_time.description: The number of hours from which incidents should be queried on the first run.

intake_key.description: Intake key to use when sending events
